subject.title: [Feature]: Reusable gateway WebSocket client SDK package

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support a low-level `@openclaw/gateway-client` WebSocket SDK, or should external clients use the higher-level `@openclaw/sdk` surface instead?
rationale: Current main has private package groundwork, but exposing it publicly would define a new device-auth, scopes, reconnect, and transport API contract that needs maintainer ownership.

options.title: Keep this issue open for SDK direction
options.body: Use this issue as the decision packet for whether a public low-level Gateway client should exist and what security/API scope it must guarantee.

options.title: Fold the request into app SDK stabilization
options.body: Redirect this only after maintainers decide that https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74704 is the sole supported external-client path and preserve this issue's lower-level Gateway requirements there.

options.title: Sponsor a public gateway-client package
options.body: Move toward publication with public exports, install docs, auth/security contract docs, Node/browser support boundaries, and live Gateway pairing proof before release.

recommendation.title: Keep this issue open for SDK direction
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the decision packet for whether a public low-level Gateway client should exist and what security/API scope it must guarantee.

likelyOwner.reason: The current private package extraction and adjacent Gateway documentation history trace most directly to steipete.
